title: Baraat Bhaag Gayi
synopsis: The night before the pheras, groom Rohan vanishes from a lavish wedding. The bride's cousin Kavya and the groom's best friend Jugnu, who start out blaming each other, have 24 hours to find him across the city, and fall for each other on the way.
content_advisory: slapstick and light peril, no violence, no strong language
ai_disclosure_note: Story and dialogue written with AI assistance; images, motion, voices and music generated with AI tools.

episodes.title: Dulha Gayab
episodes.description: The groom vanishes the night before the pheras and the 24-hour search begins.

episodes.title: Phoolon Ki Mandi
episodes.description: A chase through the flower market ends in a decoy, a clue and a glimpse of Rohan on a train.

episodes.title: Baraat Mein Baraat
episodes.description: They catch the train at the next halt, get swept into another wedding procession, and Rohan's phone rings.

episodes.title: Ghaat Ki Raat
episodes.description: Kavya learns her cousin knew everything, and a lake crossing brings the two closer.

episodes.title: Pheron Se Pehle
episodes.description: Rohan is found and brought back in time, but now the bride is missing.
